newsitem.title: HONG KONG: One dead as float overturns at Hong Kong parade.
newsitem.headline: One dead as float overturns at Hong Kong parade.

text.p: At least one person was killed and more than 20 were injured on Friday when a float overturned at a Hong Kong parade to celebrate the first day of the Lunar New Year.
Government radio said that a woman tourist was thought to have been killed, while at least 11 men and nine women were admitted to hospital.
Three of the injured were police officers, the report said.
The accident occurred in Hong Kong's Tsim Sha Tsui tourist district.
